notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten call sheet lists Emmett Cherry Festival with Tina and notes call back. Prior Gmail history is important context: the event previously said it could not accommodate an attraction area our size, and in 2024 said vendor space was completely booked. Preserve as relationship/history rather than treating as a new cold lead. Source: handwritten call notes, page 102; Adventure Zone Gmail.
